body.statement: For every external bounded experiment in \(\mathfrak E_K\), where \(K_{\mathrm{par}}\) is a nonempty compact rational polytope, \(D_v^K=D_v\cap K_{\mathrm{par}}\), and \(\bigcup_vD_v^K=K_{\mathrm{par}}\), define honesty over \(D_v^K\), separated risk over \(H_r^K\), and all parameter suprema only over \(K_{\mathrm{par}}\). Gaussian smoothing followed by rational gridding is dense for \(M_K(r)\), and outward finite-prior primal-dual programs converge to \(M_K(r)\) and terminate at every rational absolute accuracy. No recession chart, tangential average, incidence path, or recession-tail ledger is needed. This is a standalone bounded reduction and does not assert \(\mathfrak E_K\subseteq\mathfrak E\).
body.justification: The external bounded class is the required sanity check against compact-parameter Gaussian decision theory without making an impossible global-cover claim for compact label regions.
body.gap: This is a fidelity reduction to compact minimax confidence-set approximation, not a novelty claim and not a subclass relation to the unbounded experiment class.
body.consumer: Compact composite-testing and minimax expected-size procedures provide regression tests for the core-only implementation in which the recession library is disabled.
